ops.title: great-docs perf prototypes: final verdict — fast_sidebar delivers, parallel_render correct but geometry-bound; upstream deferred
ops.body:
## Decision package (go/no-go held by yasyf; nothing public per 2026-07-14 ruling)

**Verdict.** Both prototype levers are proven DOM-equivalent to stock on the full cc-transcript corpus (re-gate 3: 395/395 pages byte-identical after canonicalizing cell ids/exec counts/tmp paths; search.json/sitemap/llms.txt/robots equal; sole residual = 4 run-varying `0x…` memory-address reprs in llms-full.txt). The **<300s internal target is met by `fast_sidebar` alone**: 176s internal on a quiet machine (down from 318s flags-off post-S5, and ~774s stock 0.14.1 before this effort; historic stock walls 950–1191s). `parallel_render` is correct but adds ≈nothing on this corpus: the flat `reference/` dir (~86% of pages) is one shard because **Quarto 1.9.38's `render` accepts exactly one input positional** (extra args are forwarded to pandoc — empirically proven, exit 1), making directory granularity the structural floor; page-level sharding would pay ~2s Quarto startup per page and lose. Keep it opt-in; its value is dir-diverse corpora and future Quarto multi-input support (quarto-cli#2749).

**Branch state.** Local clone `~/Code/great-docs`, branch `perf/fast-sidebar-parallel-render` @ 72a998e (9 commits over v0.15.0/8eca1ba): 25f05b9 fast_sidebar · 643cc88 fixtures · 12ecccd parallel_render · 7bc26ee shared-griffe-loader (S5: export discovery 331.75s→2.32s, ~143×; PR-able standalone) · dfbc612/3c5de58/70f3737 fix round 1 · 19427e1 dir-granular sharding · dcd1d39 title/breadcrumb parity · 86eba95/0d18d57/72a998e review fixes. Never pushed; no issues/PRs. Targeted suites 203 passed; upstream full suite has 21 pre-existing failures (incl. a HandlerFunc export expectation).

**Number matrix** (wall / internal seconds; render step in parens):
- Stock 0.14.1 era: 950–1191 wall, ~774 internal.
- Gate 1 (quiet, 7bc26ee, 393 pages): flags-off 606.6/318.4 (5m07) · fast_sidebar 451.0/176.0 (2m56).
- Re-gate 3 (contended ~1.6×, dcd1d39, 395 pages, all equivalence-green): flags-off 989.6/505.1 (8m00) · fast_sidebar 819.3/237.2 (4m06) · parallel:4 1069.4/521.9 (8m14) · both 790.5/256.9 (4m01).
- Adversarial review: 14 findings → 11 killed by dual refuters → 3 accepted+fixed (output-file relocation in _assert_complete; malformed prior-timings tolerated; firing tests for 2 SystemExit guards). Ran on opus xhigh — codex/sol lane rate-limited until 2026-07-19.

**Deferred decisions (yasyf's):** (a) upstream engagement with Posit — issue/PR framing explicitly deferred ("no PRs or issues for now"); the branch is PR-ready when reopened. (b) Fork-pin fallback — rejected 2026-07-13. (c) Family rollout + repo-bootstrap template + CI timeout drop — contingent on a future Posit release carrying these changes.

**Follow-ups:** step-5 residual ~4min per-item cost (secondary mechanism, profiled in log 5ef7aa3); cc-transcript's `griffelib>=2.0` docs-group override becomes harmful at great-docs ≥0.15 (module collision — drop it when bumping); local cc-transcript commit e7984e23 (stale watch.TailState/TailCursor removed from great-docs.yml) still unpushed; optional quiet-machine C/D timing re-measure (equivalence already proven; only sharpens numbers). Benchmarks + artifacts: log 5ef7aa3; G1/P0 verdict: note 5f80896.
